header: CI push workflows run the manifest-derived TypeScript suites and Rust hermetic suite through scripts/run-rust-hermetic-e2e.sh; tag releases run the same Rust invocation. Cargo.lock pins the Rust dependency versions and git revisions. CI mc-module daemon tests and push/release builders use the locked subconscious source to build ck-subc; the scheduled CI builder intentionally probes default-branch HEAD as drift, while test shards consume its prebuilt artifact.
